description: Stores CouponLlama covers that match a name or a category, with how many live codes each has and its best offer. Use it to browse (“which pet stores have codes?”) or when the user isn't sure of a store's exact name.

category.description: A category slug from list_categories, such as “pets” or “home-garden”.

limit.description: How many stores to return, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

query.description: Part of a store's name, or words about what it sells.

with_codes_only.description: Leave out stores with no live code. Defaults to true.

name: search_stores
title: Search stores
